history.summary: A freehold 1BR (463 sqft) at Sky Green, D13, near Tai Seng MRT, asking $830K / $1,793 psf — below the district median $1,858 on a deep 53-txn series with a reliable ~3.5% CAGR. Low quantum, freehold and a healthy transaction base make it a serviceable entry-level investment despite a modest appreciation rate.
history.rating_rationale: Strong data quality (53 URA txns, ~3.5% resale CAGR, freehold) and listed $1,793 psf below the $1,858 median give a real value cushion. But the rate is only ~3.5% (mid), and a 463 sqft 1BR has a niche resale pool. Tai Seng/Paya Lebar Central commercial demand supports rental. score_1000 = 614 sits in the upper-middle. A solid hold, not a standout — Neutral leaning positive.
